stories.title: McConnell returns to Senate after three-month medical absence
new_facts: Confirms McConnell returned Monday and cast his first vote; reveals cause was a fall, not just 'health issues.'
Adds McConnell's own quote that he was 'briefly unconscious' after the fall.
Reveals McConnell also suffered pneumonia during his recovery.
Discloses McConnell was discharged from a rehabilitation center last month.
Notes McConnell's recovery was complicated by lingering effects of childhood polio.
Provides eyewitness scene of McConnell being wheeled from his home, plus precise 92-day count since last public appearance.
Reports McConnell was a no-show for the Senate's return, with aides saying he'll be back by Wednesday.
stories.line: McConnell returns to Senate after three-month medical absence, casting votes again.

stories.title: Saudi pipeline shutdown tightens global oil supply through contested strait
new_facts: Saudi Arabia seeking to boost oil tanker transits through Strait of Hormuz to offset pipeline loss.
Fact-check finds viral videos of Houthi attacks are old drills or unrelated fires (Texas, Russia), not real footage.
Australian Energy Minister Chris Bowen to visit Saudi Arabia to secure Australia's fuel supply.
Iran and Oman postponed a scheduled meeting on Strait of Hormuz control amid rising tensions.
stories.line: Saudi Arabia shut its East-West pipeline; oil prices rose as global supplies now depend more on the Strait of Hormuz chokepoint.

stories.title: Trump administration changes measles death counting as Pennsylvania records third fatality
new_facts: Third Pennsylvania measles death reported: 40-year-old woman died Saturday from measles complications, per coroner.
Third victim was unvaccinated with asthma and lung disease; test confirmation pending.
CDC changes measles death-counting methodology, now using NCHS mortality-tracking data amid PA outbreak.
stories.line: A Pennsylvania woman died from measles complications; the Trump administration is changing how it counts measles deaths.

stories.title: Trump dismisses AI safety concerns, sides with Nvidia against slowdown calls
new_facts: AI infrastructure stocks slumped while cybersecurity shares rose after Amodei's slowdown call.
Altman describes AI development as 'walking a narrow middle path' amid Trump's risk denial.
Trump mocks Amodei on Truth Social, calling him 'pretending to be a perfect little angel.'
stories.line: Trump dismisses AI safety concerns as a hoax and signals opposition to regulatory slowdowns, while tech leaders remain divided on development pace.

stories.title: Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran tour after pro-Palestine remarks
new_facts: New story: Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran's US tour after 'Free Palestine' remark at Sept 4 NJ concert; Kraft-linked pressure.
Adds that Macklemore was condemned by Jewish groups over his onstage comments.
Macklemore claims Robert Kraft rallied stadium owners to give Sheeran an ultimatum.
Promoter's on-record statement confirms venues barred Macklemore from tour lineup.
Reveals Macklemore was slated to perform at 10 stops of Sheeran's Loop Tour.
stories.line: Rapper Macklemore was removed from Ed Sheeran's US tour after making pro-Palestinian statements onstage.

stories.title: Trump claims Ukraine-Russia energy truce as diesel prices rise
new_facts: Trump explicitly demands Ukraine stop targeting Russian oil refineries, not just blaming war for price rise.
Zelenskiy says Ukraine will back an energy ceasefire only if the US guarantees Russia's genuine intent.
Analysts say the Iran war, not the Russia-Ukraine conflict, is the bigger driver of diesel price spikes.
New US-mediated Ukraine-Russia talks expected to begin in October.
Kremlin welcomes Trump's call for Ukraine to halt refinery strikes, says market turmoil is mainly due to Gulf conflict.
Russia gave no response to Trump's truce claim; Ukraine says it expects 'specifics from partners' before acting.
Trump publicly blames rising diesel prices mainly on the Russia-Ukraine war, not Iran.
ISW assesses Russia has made near-zero net battlefield gains since March.
Trump claims Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an energy-infrastructure truce.
Zelenskyy says Ukraine is open to halting strikes on Russian energy if Russia reciprocates.
stories.line: Trump claims to have brokered a pause in Ukraine's strikes on Russian energy infrastructure, citing U.S. diesel prices; Ukraine confirms willingness to discuss.

stories.title: Newsom rules out 2028 run against Harris
new_facts: Newsom tells CNN he won't run in 2028 if Kamala Harris enters the race.
Adds Newsom's on-record quote: 'I don't know if she runs, but we'll see.'
Ex-insider Lindy Li claims Harris secretly courted donors before Biden dropped out in 2024.
stories.line: Newsom says he won't challenge Harris in 2028; unnamed insider claims Harris made insulting statements to donors before Biden withdrew.

stories.title: EPA repeals greenhouse gas limits for power plants
new_facts: New story: EPA repeals GHG limits for power plants; Texas led US in power-plant carbon emissions in 2025.
EPA repeal overturns a 2024 Biden administration rule requiring power plants to control emissions.
Trump administration claims repeal could save power plants over $300 billion.
Notes rising power demand from AI, EVs, and manufacturing will make electricity dirtier under repeal.
Rule expected to face immediate legal challenges and could bar future administrations from regulating GHG emissions.
stories.line: EPA repeals Obama-era rules capping greenhouse gas emissions from power plants, eliminating the primary federal limit on coal and gas plant pollution.

stories.title: Mahmoud Khalil lawsuit says Columbia failed to protect pro-Palestinian activists
new_facts: Khalil sues Columbia; detained 104 days, missed child's birth, released by federal judge order
Lawsuit alleges Columbia failed to protect Khalil and other pro-Palestinian campus group members from harassment
Lawsuit uses specific legal standard 'deliberate indifference' to describe Columbia's alleged failure

stories.title: Treasury yields spike to 5% as Fed prepares rate hike amid inflation
new_facts: 10-year Treasury yield nearing 5%, a level last seen in October 2023, ahead of Fed decision.
Odds of additional Fed rate hikes this year have grown ahead of this week's decision.
Specifies expected hike size: quarter percentage point at September meeting.
Introduces Fed chair Warsh, whose credibility is tested amid inflation above target and tariff/oil uncertainty pushing toward a hike.
stories.line: Treasury yields spiked to 5% as markets brace for a likely Federal Reserve interest rate increase this week amid persistent inflation.
